The '''Drowned Reliquary''' is a location in the {{zone|Moonglade Marsh}}. It can be accessed from the {{zone|Reefguard Pass}} in the {{zone|Murkwater Depths}} and is a location to [[Hunting|Hunt]] [[Tidetot]]s, [[Hydrospear]]s and [[Seacurse]]s.

== Features ==
=== Mobs ===
{{MobSprite|Tidetot}}s, {{MobSprite|Hydrospear}}s, and {{MobSprite|Seacurse}}s swim around the area. They can be killed for {{Item|Gill Membrane}}s or [[Hunting|hunted]] for their {{Attr|Undead Fortune}} [[Attribute]].

{{MobSprite|Hydrospear}}s also drop a {{Item|Sturdy Bone}} {{Green|10%}} of the time.
